overview.short_description: A girl who grew up with Roger's help.
overview.brief: The village where Ruby lived was attacked by werewolves. At the time of crisis, Roger appeared to help them repel the werewolves. Roger taught Ruby how to fight and gave her a sickle so that she could protect herself and the village.
overview.story:
It was another peaceful night in a remote village among the Dark Forest before it was interrupted by the vicious howling of the wolves from afar. In a small cabin, a little girl was kneeling on her bed, praying. Next to her stood a disproportionately giant scythe. She was praying for the return of the legendary hunter - Roger. Only he could save the village from being vandalized by the wolves.

Years earlier, Roger saved her family by accident when he was wandering in the Land of Dawn. His bravery took a huge toll on the wolves. At the request from the elderly in the village, Roger finally stayed to train the villagers. One day, he left the village without any notice and no trace to be found.

What happens in the fairy tales can seldom be the same in reality. On a silent, moonless night, Pale Tusk, the wolf king, caught the village off guard and sneaked in with his pack. In the end, her grandfather and grandmother died trying to protect Ruby, who in turn made a narrow escape by hiding under the corpses of her grandparents. No one could imagine that from the moment she witnessed her grandparents' death, her character would completely change. Outraged, she got back on her feet, picked up the scythes, rushed into the wolves, and slaughtered almost all of them. Under her seemingly weak appearance now lies an unsettling, irritable soul. Pale Tusk was the only survivor among the wolves. Staring at the skyline, Ruby decided to make a happy ending for all the good people in every story. Pale Tusk was never defeated before but this time it came in the severest way. Ruby gradually regained consciousness after Pale Tusk left. Now, whenever the wolves howl, her eyes become once more filled with rage.

abilities.name: Let's Dance!
abilities.description:
Ruby's skills have a 75% Spell Vamp Ratio (her Basic Attacks cannot trigger Lifesteal). For every 1% HP lost, her Spell Vamp Ratio increases by 1%, up to 150%.
After each skill cast, Ruby can dash to another location and gain 8-25 Physical & Magic Defense (scales with level) for 4s (stacks up to 3 times).

abilities.name: Be Good!
abilities.description: Ruby swings her scythe, dealing 280/320/360/400/440/480<scaleAD> (+110% Total Physical Attack)</scaleAD> <physicalDamage>Physical Damage</physicalDamage> to enemies hit. She then unleashes a shockwave in the same direction, dealing 140/160/180/200/220/240<scaleAD> (+55% Total Physical Attack)</scaleAD> <physicalDamage>Physical Damage</physicalDamage> to enemies hit and slowing them by 40% for 1s.

abilities.name: Don't Run, Wolf King!
abilities.description: Ruby swings her scythe around herself twice, each swing dealing 60/85/110/135/160/185<scaleAD> (+55% Total Physical Attack)</scaleAD> <physicalDamage>Physical Damage</physicalDamage> to nearby enemies, stunning them for 0.5s, and slowly pulling them toward her.

abilities.name: I'm Offended!
abilities.description: Ruby sweeps her scythe in the target direction, dealing 600/900/1200<scaleAD> (+200% Total Physical Attack)</scaleAD> <physicalDamage>Physical Damage</physicalDamage> to enemies hit, pulling them toward her, and stunning them for 0.5s.

combos.name: TEAMFIGHT COMBOS
combos.description: In teamfights, use Ruby's 1st Skill to slow the enemy at a distance, and close in with her Passive dash. Then use her 2nd Skill to stun the enemies in range and use her Ultimate to pull back those who try to escape.

combos.name: LANING COMBOS
combos.description: In the laning phase, Use Ruby's 1st Skill to slow down the enemy, and the dash from her Passive to get closer. Then cast Ruby's Ultimate to pull the enemy into melee range and her 2nd Skill to keep them stunned. Finally, spam her Basic Attacks to finish them off.

relationships.description: Ruby works best with heroes who can deal high AOE burst damage. Their skills can deal more damage to enemies who are stunned and pulled by her 2nd and Ultimate skills. Such as Pharsa and Kadita.
Ruby is strong against Fighter heroes with high burst damage. She can easily survive their burst with her excellent Regen and Lifesteal abilities. Such as Aldous and Guinevere.
Ruby is countered by Marksman heroes with good Mobility. Because they can easily dodge her 2nd and Ultimate skills. Like Wanwan and Irithel.
